items.text: Ridiculous QUESTIONABLE list this week (Chase, Higgins, Jefferson, Addison, Jeanty, McConkey, Flowers, Stevenson, Kamara, McLaurin etc). Bracing for messy Sunday morning actives.
items.why: Long Q list on final Friday board; many stars.
items.implication: Monitor morning inactives closely; high variance for lineups/DFS.
items.opportunity: If any OUT, clear beneficiary bumps (e.g. Jeanty -> backup, Chase/Higgins -> Brown already loved).

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown; ETR final Sunday board lists him OUT. Corroborated by Rapoport and team report.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week; final injury report.
items.implication: Eagles backfield to Will Shipley (lead) + Dameon Pierce; major downgrade for PHI offense and Hurts.
items.opportunity: RB1 snaps/carries/red-zone for Shipley; TE Dallas Goedert (IN) and remaining WRs elevated targets.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle) for Sunday night vs ATL on ETR board and Rapoport confirmation.
items.why: Left ankle; missed practice; final designation.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded; Huntley likely start; Flowers/Henry/Andrews usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for Zay Flowers (Q) and Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely if Flowers limited.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (not on final injury report) after ankle maintenance/limited practice; full-go comments.
items.why: Ankle maintenance but cleared final report; player said full-go.
items.implication: Expected better role after Week 4 criticism.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries vs DET; clear of Allgeier.

items.text: Quentin Johnston ruled OUT; Schefter confirms Chargers OUT list includes Johnston, Alt, James.
items.implication: Ladd McConkey (Q) and other Chargers WRs see target bump; Herbert volume concentrated.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone for McConkey and remaining pass-catchers.

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert listed IN on ETR board. Daniels returning (Rapoport); Goedert cleared.
items.why: Daniels full practice/upgrade post-elbow; Olave/Goedert cleared final report.
items.implication: WAS offense upgrade with Daniels back; NO/PHI receiving stable.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for all three; reverse any prior backup beneficiaries.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Week 5; second straight miss. Listed on ETR OUT board.
items.implication: Jets RB committee to backups; Wilson/targets elevated if pass-heavy.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup carries and potential receiving work.

items.text: Stefon Diggs, Michael Pittman, Pat Bryant all OUT on ETR board. Bryant to short-term IR (Rapoport); Diggs hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring (Diggs), injury (Pittman), ankle to IR (Bryant, miss ~4 games).
items.implication: WAS WR depth to McLaurin/Deebo/Samuel; IND to Downs/Pierce/Warren; DEN WR to Sutton/Humphrey.
items.opportunity: Target share spikes for remaining WRs/TEs.

items.text: Mike Evans off injury report, no designation (clear/ACTIVE). 49ers rule out Nick Bosa and Kyle Juszczyk; plan to activate Mykel Williams.
items.why: No injury designation on final report.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected for SF vs SEA.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage criticism. Not on final IR; account for downside but upgrade workload.
items.why: Fan/media pressure on Week 4 usage + cleared report; maintenance only.
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play; higher floor/ceiling than last week.
items.opportunity: Expanded snaps, carries, goal-line vs Allgeier split.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN as his WR8; volume + red-zone + matchup vs struggling Titans secondary.
items.why: Target hog, red-zone usage, soft TEN matchup.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high ranking confidence.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; 'Brown Gobbler' nickname push for target/fantasy gobbling. Workload + matchup vs soft run D; Bengals WR injuries help.
items.why: Heavy workload, pass-catching, MIA matchup, CIN WR injuries (Chase/Higgins Q).
items.implication: Elite RB start this week; nickname campaign.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: sore knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, and coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer tendencies. Frustration over low second-half targets noted. Playing this week but stacked risks.
items.why: Knee + shoulder + QB/coaching uncertainty stacking; post-halftime target frustration.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; short-term startable but volatility high.
items.opportunity: If limited, Wan'Dale or others, but primary long-term caution.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH). Hates Jordan Addison (WR41), Mark Andrews (TE17), Cam Skattebo (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB28), Jalen Hurts (QB15).
items.why: Loves: volume/matchup gifts. Hates: tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency/game script, banged-up line for Hurts.
items.opportunity: Target/red-zone edges for loves; avoid low-upside hates.

Player-specific: Love workload upgrade (4.8 clear Allgeier, better role expected despite ankle/maintenance); Nabers multi-risk (knee/shoulder/QB/coaching) + frustration. Braced for messy Q list.

Primary official OUTs/ACTIVES: Johnston out, Evans clear, Bryant IR, Bosa/Juszczyk out, Mykel Williams activate, Lamar/others. Essential status rulings.
